Port of Calbayog. The territorial jurisdiction of the Port of
Calbayog situated in Barangay Poblacion, Calbayog City, Province of Samar, is
hereby delineated and established, particularly described as follows:
Beginning at a point marked 1 on the plan, being S. 37 deg. 36' W.,
462.47 m. from BLLM No. 1, Calbayog City, Samar, thence:

@ffice of the President of the Philippines

PPA Jurisdiction. The Calbayog Port Zone, as delineated,
is hereby placed under the administrative jurisdiction of the PPA, which shall,
consistent with the regional industrial plans of the government, implement a
program for the proper zoning, planning, development and utilization of the port.

Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts
thereof. which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed,
amended or modified accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Executive Order is
declared invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby
shall remain valid and subsisting.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect
immediately upon publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 14th day of March
of our Lord, Two Thousand and Thirteen.
By the President:
PAQUITO NOCHOA, JR.
Executive Secretary
